text: 下周一，将有2只新股可申购，分别为北交所新股南方乳业和创业板新股联亚药业。其中，南方乳业发行价为14.21元/股。该公司是贵州本土乳企的“领头羊”，拥有“山花”“花都牧场”“贵草”等乳制品品牌，在贵州省内市场占有较高份额。虽然近年来积极开拓贵州省以外市场，包括推广至湖南、四川、重庆、广西、云南、广东等周边省市市场，但目前该公司产品收入仍高度集中于贵州省内，贵州省内的主营业务收入占比超过90%。（第一财经）
text_en: Next Monday, two new stocks will be available for subscription: Beijing Stock Exchange newcomer Nanfang Dairy and ChiNext newcomer Lianya Pharmaceutical. Among them, Nanfang Dairy's issue price is 14.21 yuan per share. The company is the leader among local dairy enterprises in Guizhou and owns dairy brands such as Shanhua, Huadu Ranch and Guicao, holding a relatively high share of the Guizhou provincial market. Although it has actively expanded markets outside Guizhou in recent years, including promotion to neighboring provincial markets such as Hunan, Sichuan, Chongqing, Guangxi, Yunnan and Guangdong, the company's product revenue is still highly concentrated within Guizhou, with main business revenue from within Guizhou accounting for more than 90%. (Yicai)
